open_points.subject: sandbox network isolation
open_points.text: K-02 requires a function to run with “no network”, while A03 defines `network(environment) = own_loopback_only` and says the namespace has its “own loopback — up”.
open_points.question: Does “no network” prohibit all networking, including loopback, or does it mean only that nothing outside the execution is reachable?
options: Permit loopback communication within the execution
Keep loopback up but prohibit every use of it by function code
Provide no usable network interface, including loopback
open_points.default_guess: Treat K-02 as prohibiting external connectivity only, keep loopback up, and classify function socket use as `sandbox_violation`.

open_points.subject: constant-time token comparison verification
open_points.text: 12. A token is compared in constant time with the owner token and with each agent token.
open_points.question: What verification witness must establish the constant-time comparison requirement now that it is no longer covered by the witnessed uniqueness test?
options: Give this test its own verification witness
Make the existing token-uniqueness witness cover both requirements
Leave constant-time comparison without a named witness
open_points.default_guess: Give the constant-time comparison test its own verification witness.

open_points.subject: atomic value publication
open_points.text: 2. A crash during a value write leaves either no file or the complete file.
open_points.question: What verification witness must demonstrate crash-atomic value publication after its witness reference was removed?
options: Use one shared store-atomicity witness for tests 2, 3 and 5
Leave the required test without a named witness
open_points.default_guess: Add a dedicated crash/fault-injection verification witness.

open_points.subject: failed store call atomicity
open_points.text: 3. A failed store call leaves no partial record.
open_points.question: What verification witness must demonstrate that every failed store call changes no record after its witness reference was removed?
options: Use one shared store-atomicity witness for tests 2, 3 and 5
Leave the required test without a named witness
open_points.default_guess: Add a dedicated transaction-failure verification witness.

open_points.subject: digest-checked immutable file publication
open_points.text: 5. A value write whose bytes do not match their digest or size publishes no file; writing equal bytes again leaves the published file unchanged.
open_points.question: What verification witness must demonstrate digest/size checking and non-overwrite after its witness reference was removed?
options: Use one shared store-atomicity witness for tests 2, 3 and 5
Leave the required test without a named witness
open_points.default_guess: Add a dedicated publication-integrity verification witness.

open_points.subject: cleanup after oversized function file output
open_points.text: A function writing a file one byte over `spool_file_bytes_max` concludes `resource_exhausted` — under release v1 already by `output_bytes`, which is lower — and leaves nothing in the spool.
open_points.question: When `output_bytes` triggers before `spool_file_bytes_max`, are any bytes already considered spooled and, if so, are they removed immediately despite A13 rule 3 saying bytes from failures other than a spool-ceiling refusal remain until spool cleanup or replacement?
options: Reject the output before publishing any bytes to the run spool
Publish partial or temporary spool bytes and remove them immediately
Leave any already-spooled unnamed bytes until ordinary spool cleanup or replacement
open_points.default_guess: Reject the oversized sandbox output before publishing any bytes to the run spool, so the test leaves nothing there.
